style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, hard moonlight
subject: aardwolf, striped hyena build, raised mane, tan fur; same animal
second_characters: termites in neckties like clerks, huge at the lens

props.can: an empty tin can, carried, thrown, caught on the move, waved

environment: moonlit savanna, a dense wall of red clay mounds close behind him, a track stuffed with roots and stones, truck headlights across them
lighting: hard moonlight, twin headlight beams raking across him, warm bounce off clay, dust burning in the beams
motion_rule: The camera orbits the hero and never stops, a full circle by 10.00: mounds, headlights and the moon sweep behind him edge to edge every beat. New shot size every beat, medium to close. Termites rush INTO the lens every beat. One hero action per beat: he throws his body the full frame width, filling half the frame height, muzzle to the lens.

audio.rate: 3.9 syllables per second; each line fits its beat
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0; speech ends by 7.20; then wind and claws
audio.lip_sync: muzzle to the lens, jaw opens every syllable, mouth empty while speaking

timeline.a: a clay wall fills the screen, he bursts through it into the lens, can swinging; termites blow past
hurls the can out of frame, body after it; a necktied termite tumbles across the lens
swings the other way against the orbit, mane whipping; two termites climb the lens
sweeps a paw through the swarm on the move; termites surge into the lens
charges the full width after the can, scoops it up on the run; termites pour over the lens
waves the can overhead like a club, belly fatter; the swarm spirals at the glass
throws his shoulder edge to edge, mounds tearing behind; three termites ride his mane past
tosses the can back over his head and twists after it; termites leap at the lens
wheels against the orbit, belly swinging him wide; termites climb the glass in a column
plows across frame, belly dragging dust; termites part ahead in a wave
catches the falling can on the run, swings it flat at the lens; termites sheet across
flings the can away, drives his shoulders across, eyes to the lens; a termite spreads its legs
belly swells and yanks him sideways, he throws head and shoulders into the lens, teeth bared; A SWARM bursts out
skids sideways on his belly, legs splayed, paws limp, dust burning in the beams, muzzle to the lens; termites pour over him
the can flies back in and knocks a mound beside him; termites stream between camera and hero
the camera closes the circle, he slides out past the right edge, limp paw last; the can stands alone in the beam

must_appear: clay wall filling the screen at 0.00, he bursts through it; the can thrown at 0.62, caught at 2.40, waved at 3.10; a close snarl at 7.20; at 7.85 legs splayed, paws limp
negative_prompt: a hero running at the camera on his feet, a prop held still and worked in place, a bare empty background, darkness, silent opening, still last second, hero riding anything, view from behind, lowered head during speech, parked camera, push in, motionless background, tongue out while speaking, subtitles, printed words, digits, Cyrillic or Latin, speech bubble, black bars, speech after 7.20, English speech, a second hyena, wide shot, growl, roar
